title: Population analyses reveal heterogenous encoding in the medial prefrontal cortex during naturalistic foraging
goal: Reproduce the source's mPFC population-encoding findings for distance to the goal/threat location and event/action-related population states during naturalistic foraging, retaining each named result's original cohorts, neural inputs, time windows, contrasts and indispensable controls. Preserve Figure 6B avoidance-versus-escape discrimination as a named empirical component. Assess improvement of that component on its same original endpoint only after source equivalence and scientific criteria are qualified; component success alone does not establish completion of the registered finding family.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Retained empirical result family: distance/location encoding, event/action discrimination and population-state differences around naturalistic foraging and avoidance. The source spatial target is distance from the rat's head to the goal/threat E-zone center, not arbitrary predator coordinates. Preserve source-specific cohorts and interpretation limits; exact complete family panel and criteria remain unfrozen. Figure 6B is meaningful partial coverage within this family, not an unrelated proxy. No all-figures or whole-paper requirement is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained source work: partial_primary_coverage: Figure 6B retrospective within-session avoidance-versus-escape head-withdrawal discrimination on the original processed [-1000,+1000] ms inputs, all 40 bins per unit and all 40 source sessions. Retain source-seed-622 stratified fivefold pooled OOF balanced accuracy, equal-session aggregation and real/shuffled comparisons. Its ordered decoder endpoint is scientifically legitimate; it does not alone cover distance/location or population-transition findings. [coverage: named_empirical_component_source_unqualified]
component_engineering_and_reference_evidence: The complete foraging programme, independent BNB equation reconstruction, protected endpoint checker, source-protocol fold recipes and separately named seeded controls remain useful evidence. Software checks or probability fidelity do not establish original author execution or scientific improvement.
prospective_extension: Behavior-rich baselines, grouped animal/episode/time holdouts and trajectory-preserving nulls remain explicit extensions unless independently authenticated as the source protocol. They must not be retroactively required for literal Figure 6B reconstruction or presented as its original evaluation.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful retained implementations with their declared coverage. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

Persist regenerated or recovered fold identities with source seed 622 and environment provenance.
retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Evaluate every original HW row once out of fold and all 40 session scores against the source-conformant BernoulliNB rerun on identical source-seed-622 folds and the separately reported published 0.7271. Calibrate using the predeclared tolerance; report other comparator results separately.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Paper score, source-conformant author BNB rerun, unseeded historical shuffle, any documented newly seeded shuffle and local logistic reference are separately named. Regenerating source-protocol folds with seed 622 is admissible with paired membership and calibrated provenance; a changed split scheme cannot validate the same-task claim.
